The second hand ticks 12 times while the hour hand completes one full rotation. This is because the hour hand completes a rotation every 12 hours, and there are 60 minutes in an hour, and 60 seconds in a minute. So, 12 hours * 60 minutes/hour * 60 seconds/minute = 43,200 seconds. The second hand moves once per second, therefore it ticks 43,200 times.
